sample_type.evidence_source: The sample consists of 'adolescents and young adults' including 'dropouts' and 'high school graduates' but is not described as nationally-representative, college students, or clinical/patient. [page/3/Text/4] Of the 182 dropouts, 60 had graduated or received their GED by T3.

ethnicity.evidence_source: [page/4/Text/4] Responses included 'white', 'Black or African American', 'Asian', 'American Indian or Alaska native', 'Native Hawaiian or other Pacific islander', 'Hispanic/ Central American', 'Cape Verdean', 'Haitian/Caribbean', and 'other'. The selection of more than one response was permitted. In order to create one measure of race and ethnicity, all respondents who indicated Hispanic or Latino origin were grouped together, irrespective of racial designation. Dummy variables for Black or African American and Hispanic or Latino origin were created.
